notes.title: Underworld Re: Card v0.5.0 Patch
notes.content:
[b]New features[/b]

[list]
[*] The Codex function is open, and the entire card library can be reviewed.
[*] Added hero hairstyle components and facial features components.
[*] Adjust the text color of the card.
[*] It is now possible to view detailed information about heroes and monsters.
[/list]


[b]Functional fix[/b]

[list]
[*] Attack keywords have been corrected, and upgraded cards have been adjusted.
[*] Block keywords have been corrected, and upgraded cards have been adjusted.
[*] Strike keywords have been corrected, and upgraded cards have been adjusted.
[*] Guard keywords have been corrected, and upgraded cards have been adjusted.
[*] Corrected the keywords and description of the card.
[*] Fixed the issue of head tilt during attacking and receiving attacks.
[*] Fixed keyword errors for Lucky and Great Lucky
[*] The Avatar's hair and eyes have been corrected and can now be dyed correctly.
[*] The settlement process has been rewritten so that the enemy will now play cards in the correct order.
[*] Player character materials have been updated, and player characters can be identified by the person holding the card.
[*] Fixed an issue where music playback would be interrupted.
[*] All avatar frames are modified to new square specifications.
[*] Other features and balance fixes.
[/list]
